title: NO CLOSE CALL ON THE FLOOR
why: A crawler hanging on him bites through a roll, so it can put him down in the middle of one. The roll then stayed frozen while he was down and every revive handed it back: a round that reached him on the floor paid CLOSE CALL (25 and the roll stamina), a round right after he got up paid again, and he slid on with the old roll. Proven in the cloud: rolled, downed by a crawler bite, one round on the floor paid 25, got up, one more round paid 25. Going down now ends the roll, and a man who is down or dying gets no CLOSE CALL. A roll on his feet pays exactly as before.
now: A round that reaches you while you are down, or right after you get up, no longer pays a CLOSE CALL, and you no longer slide on after getting up.
